name: open-scholar
description: Open Scholar — AI-assisted research skills for the social sciences, from research question to submission-ready manuscript and replication package.

plugins.name: open-scholar-skill
plugins.description: The full social-science research pipeline as skills: idea formalization, systematic literature review, theory and hypotheses, research design with power analysis, causal identification, EDA, analysis with publication-quality tables and figures, computational social science, LLM annotation, section-by-section drafting, citation verification, journal formatting, ethics, replication packages, and simulated peer review. Ships specialized reviewer, code-review, and verification subagents, plus a PreToolUse data-safety guard.
